753:t_010:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's do this! We'll put everything we've got into these five minutes!」

753:t_010:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, begin your attack! Let's go!」

753:t_010:4.en:
$n
「We'll stop you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll protect every life in this universe!!」

753:t_010:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Come at me with all your strength. Feel the immensity of what you challenge... and the resolve of one who will become God.」

753:t_010:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This is to bless the new world.」

753:t_011:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「How can this guy be so strong?!」

753:t_011:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But we're still damaging him! We just have to keep piling it on!」

753:t_011:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...A hundred ones make a hundred... A hundred hundreds make ten thousand...」

753:t_011:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's how I've been paying off my debts!」

753:t_011:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But that logic will not work here. God is immortal.」

753:t_012:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「That's impossible! This can't be...!」

753:t_012:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「All the damage we've dealt is healing...!」

753:t_012:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「So everything we've done was in vain.」

753:t_012:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It pains me... Had you quietly accepted your fate, I would never have had to inflict despair on you like this.」

753:t_012:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But now you understand, don't you? Even if you stop the Supreme God, it will become meaningless in an instant.」

753:t_012:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「...It's no use... Our dimensional barrier can't contain that enormous amount of $$次元力|lc$$...」

753:t_012:9.en:
$$スザク$$
「Then even if we defeat him...!」

753:t_012:10.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Is there no way to stop his super-regeneration...?」

753:t_012:13.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are falling... into a darkness deeper and blacker than despair... silently, without anyone knowing...」

753:t_012:14.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I shall save you from it. By snuffing out your lives.」

753:t_013:1.en:
$$ボス$$
「He still had that much fighting power left?!」

753:t_013:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I did not have it. I have just created it.」

753:t_013:4.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「He creates something from nothing... So that is... the power of God...」

753:t_013:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even this will not be enough to break the fighting spirit that has brought you this far...」

753:t_013:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So I shall use this as well.」

753:t_075:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「They are $$ネオ・リアクター$$s.」

753:t_075:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「They are false lives I prepared to draw out each $$スフィア$$'s power after I had gathered them all.」

753:t_075:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I have now given them $$フェイク・スフィア$$s... substitutes, so they can serve as my hands and feet.」

753:t_075:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Does each one correspond to a $$スフィア$$?!」

753:t_075:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$, $$クロウ$$... and $n. With the Supreme God reborn and them here, I shall free you from your long suffering.」

753:t_075:10.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Sleep in my arms, Reactors of old.」

753:t_075:11.en:
$$メール$$
「Don't talk like Darling's useless now! You're the one who's a nuisance to the universe!」

753:t_075:12.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I understand your unwillingness to accept it. But...」

753:t_075:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't act like you know everything! What the hell do you understand?!」

753:t_075:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You don't know the first thing about other people.」

753:t_075:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you understood anyone's heart, you could never accept the universe's collapse!」

753:t_075:16.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is not so. At the very least, I understand exactly how you feel right now.」

753:t_075:17.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Despair has finally taken hold of your hearts. The fighting spirit that brought you this far is about to break.」

753:t_075:20.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「As long as you do not vanish beyond the causal horizon, you will someday be reborn into new lives in a new universe.」

753:t_075:21.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Let us rejoice together that we can cast off our entire past. Today is a beginning, not an ending.」

753:t_075:23.en:
$n
「...You really... don't understand a damn thing...」

753:t_075:25.en:
$n
「As long as we're alive, we can fight! If you want to break our fighting spirit, kill us!」

753:t_075:26.en:
$n
「You fear the power of life...! If you think you can snuff it out, just try!」

753:t_075:27.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...How sad... It may have been 120 million years since I last felt this way.」

753:t_075:28.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I shall overcome that pain. Granting your wish will be my final act of mercy...」

753:t_073:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Thank you for waiting, everyone. Humble remnants of $$サイデリアル$$ that we are... we have come to lend you our aid.」

753:t_073:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Leave the enemies around you to us!」

753:t_073:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「You must defeat the source of the distortion!」

753:t_073:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$サルディアス$$! $$ダバラーン$$ and $$尸刻$$, too!」

753:t_073:5.en:
$$カティ$$
「This is Brigadier General $$カティ・マネキン$$ of the $$新地球連邦軍$$.」

753:t_073:7.en:
$$カティ$$
「We will commit all our forces to supporting $c! So don't give up hope!」

753:t_073:8.en:
$$イザーク$$
「Leave Earth's defense to us!」

753:t_073:9.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「We're counting on you at the front!」

753:t_073:10.en:
$$アスラン$$
「$$イザーク$$! $$ディアッカ$$, too!」

753:t_073:11.en:
$$イズモ$$
「The $$アルテア$$ army will join you! We'll fight to the very last moment!」

753:t_073:13.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Old man $$イズモ$$ came here too?!」

753:t_073:14.en:
$$アマタ$$
「No, $$カグラ$$. He's our dad.」

753:t_073:16.en:
$$ヘンケン$$
「No one over here has given up either!」
